scope: Exact artifact receipt runs only; all logged child roots, successful portfolio roots and live refusals included; prior attempts, probes, saved rendering and browser QA excluded
limitations: Dollar figures are current-tariff estimates, not invoices or balance attribution.
Cache/shared hits preserve original usage and are excluded from current-run spending.
Reasoning tokens are already part of output tokens and not added twice.
Provider usage sums already include retries; do not multiply by attempts.
Endpoints and UsageReported flags are not retained by journal v3.
Absent logged native-failed child roots remain explicit; ordinary log/timing comparison is evidence, not an invoice.
